The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. • Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life-whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Figma’s AI Insights team, within Research, is hiring a builder with exceptional design craft and deep AI fluency. You will report to Noam Segal, Director of AI Insights.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity and Authorization
description:
Who we are
At Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale. Our platform integrates a streamlined model development environment, MLOps capabilities, and novel features for collaboration, reuse, and reproducibility - all of which make data science teams more productive, reduce time to value, and ensure compliance. Our customers - like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy - are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented - and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai
What we are building
Domino’s Identity and Access platform (IDSM) is the foundation for how customers in some of the world’s most regulated industries manage who can see and do what. We’re evolving it into a centralized, relationship-based authorization framework built on SpiceDB, and you’d be the technical anchor for its next phase.

•
A unified authorization model. Extend a centralized, fine-grained, relationship-based model across the platform, replacing feature-specific permission checks with consistent, reusable primitives.

•
Production-grade operations. Harden the authorization layer for the scale, reliability, and security that enterprise and public-sector customers expect.

•
A thoughtful migration path. Make the sequencing and design calls that let us retire legacy access checks without disrupting customers along the way.

•
Groups and organizations that mirror real customers. Rethink how we model groups and organizational hierarchies so large enterprises can represent their teams the way they actually work.

•
Cloud-native identity. Deepen integration with cloud workload identity, starting with AWS IRSA and extending to Azure and GCP equivalents.

•
Foundations other teams build on. Design core identity and access capabilities, with clean interfaces and flexible abstractions, that engineers across the company can adopt with confidence.

•
A stronger way of building. Set the patterns for how the team uses AI-assisted development to ship high-quality features faster, without compromising security or code quality.

What your impact will be

•
Set the architectural direction. Design identity and access solutions that meet customer demands for managing user and group access, and are secure, scalable, and built on primitives teams can reuse.

•
Bring clarity to complex decisions. Articulate the architecture clearly enough that the rest of Engineering can rally around it.

•
Be the go-to authority. Engineers and teams building on IDSM will bring their auth questions to you, and your technical judgment will carry real influence.

•
Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, unblock engineers facing ambiguity, and champion flexible abstractions and well-thought-out interfaces.

•
Increase velocity and reduce maintenance. Improve our architecture, including removing tech debt, so the team ships faster with less ongoing maintenance.

•
Shape how we build with AI. Establish patterns for using AI-assisted development to deliver high-quality features faster without compromising security or rigor.

•
Foster ownership and urgency. Help the team know what to build and value both quality and speed of iteration and contribute to experiences that make identity and user management easier for the enterprises we serve.

What we look for in this role

• A track record of evolving an enterprise-grade authorization system under real production traffic, with strong opinions about the architecture of these system

title: Asset Resolution Counsel
description:
About World Business Lenders
World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general purpose short-term real estate collateralized commercial loans to a broad customer base comprised of small and medium sized businesses throughout the United States that lack access to traditional funding. WBL services its loan portfolio and loan portfolios for third parties, specializing in the management of non-performing loan pools and REO.
Overview

• The Asset Resolution Counsel is responsible for leading the legal strategy, portfolio management, and resolution efforts for a portfolio of non-performing commercial loans secured primarily by real estate. This role serves as a strategic business partner responsible for maximizing recoveries while minimizing legal risk, loss severity, and resolution timelines.

• Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders, outside counsel, loan servicing teams, and borrowers, the Asset Resolution Counsel develops and executes resolution strategies through negotiation, restructuring, litigation, foreclosure, bankruptcy, receivership, REO disposition, and other loss mitigation initiatives.

• This position requires sound legal judgment, strong financial and analytical skills, and the ability to balance business objectives with legal and regulatory compliance.

Essential Functions:

• Manage and monitor a non-performing real estate collateralized commercial loan portfolio, including REO, toward most effective and efficient resolution

• Supervise, train and develop Asset Resolution Department staff

• Conduct proactive and effective portfolio management in accordance with established performance standards

• Monitor and manage commercial litigation/bankruptcy/foreclosure activities, functions and deadlines

• Direct/monitor/liaise with in-house and outside attorneys, collection agencies and other vendors that support the loss mitigation effort

• Interact with customers and their counsel

• Negotiate and propose settlement agreements and bidding instructions

• Monitor loss mitigation workout performance and loss severity trends

• Implement and communicate loss mitigation decisions

• Maintain delinquency and loss mitigation reporting, including trend analysis and assessment

• Conduct comprehensive analysis of debtors' financial position, credit status, personal background, and historical payment performance

• Facilitate negotiation and conflict resolution

• Perform extensive quarterly review of portfolio being managed to confirm or reassess recovery estimates

• Monitor related expenses (taxes, maintenance, utilities, fees, etc.) and timely propose protective advances

• Participate in budget preparation for the Asset Resolution Department.

• Other projects and duties as assigned.

Requirements

• Education: 

• Law degree (from a nationally accredited U.S. law school is preferred).

• Experience:

• Experience working in commercial litigation, bankruptcy, foreclosure, and real estate loss mitigation

• Experience successfully managing non-performing loan (NPL) pools and REO portfolios

• Experience supervising, developing, and mentoring case management staff

• Litigation experience and familiarity with litigation management tools

• Experience working for a U.S.-based company.

• Financial Analysis & Business Acumen

• Litigation & Bankruptcy Management

• Negotiation & Conflict Resolution

• Leadership & Team Development

• Vendor & Outside Counsel Management

• Executive Communication & Presentation Skills

• Data-Driven Decision Making

• Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Exceptional Written and Verbal English Communication Skills

• Professional, Personable, and Customer-Focused Interpersonal Skills

• Sound Judgment, Integrity, and Accountability

title: Principal Engineer - Core Cloud Platform
description:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents - including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us.

About the Role: 

The Core Cloud Platform team is responsible for AlphaSense's entire cloud infrastructure, including AWS account management, networking, data storages, and Kubernetes clusters. We build the underlying platform that supports hundreds of services and is used by over 400 globally distributed engineers.

We're scaling into a cell-based architecture, and the number of cells we run is growing fast, taking our Kubernetes footprint from dozens of clusters toward hundreds. That takes the platform in three directions at once: infrastructure configuration becomes a first-class layer with its own lifecycle, independent of application code; provisioning a new cell becomes a days-long automated operation rather than a multi-week effort; and cross-cell control points become standard, reusable, and consistent everywhere.

This is a Principal Engineer role with real breadth within the cloud platform. You'll set the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform as it scales with AlphaSense's growth, and take dedicated ownership of the cloud-side configuration and Helm chart layer that every service depends on. Data storages are a critical part of this surface, and we're looking for genuine depth there.

It requires a deep cloud of both operational and software development skills, the ability to lead ambitious technical programmes, and the credibility to set direction with Engineering leaders and very senior engineers across dozens of teams.

We're looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI tooling in their day-to-day work, appreciates the productivity value it brings, and is motivated to make our infrastructure ever-more AI friendly.

What You’ll Do:  

• Own the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform

• Own cloud-side configuration and the Helm chart layer for Cloud Core

• Build the cell registry and automate provisioning to take new cell setup from weeks to days

• Design the cross-cell gate mechanism as the reusable standard checkpoint across every cell

• Own, operate and evolve our Cloud and Kubernetes platform, including our data storage layers

• Make operations (upgrades, patching, lifecycle management) routine across hundreds of clusters

• Continuously improve the security, reliability, cost efficiency and performance of our infrastructure

• Champion standards and drive initiatives to promote uniformisation and eliminate duplication

• Enable truly self-service and agentic workflow patterns that support a Build it - Own it model

• Build tooling and AI powered integrations that reduce the cognitive load in cloud 

• Architect, design and implement simple and maintainable solutions

Who You Are:

• Extremely experienced in Kubernetes and its various components, containerisation and AWS cloud

• Proven track record of running Kubernetes and Cloud based production SaaS systems at scale

• Experience operating Kubernetes as a large fleet with hundreds of clusters

• Strong knowledge of data storages across SQL, MongoDB, ClickH

description:

The Instrumentation and Controls Engineer is responsible for developing, analyzing, and integrating measurement and control systems to support reactor operation. This position may reside within powerhouse engineering supporting power generation or within the isotopes organization supporting isotope reactors.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Design instrumentation and control systems that integrate sensors, instrumentation, actuators, and other control components

• Lead the technical execution of assigned systems as a responsible engineer that coordinates requirements, design, testing, and commissioning

• Experience developing system and component level requirements

• Experience designing control strategies and automating industrial equipment and processes

• Experience managing, communicating with, and providing oversight to EPC contractors, vendors, and equipment manufacturers

• Experience with analog and digital circuits

• Experience with digital networks and communication protocols

• Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

title: Principal Medicaid Pharmacy Strategist, PDL, Pricing & Contracting (Any city, IL
description:
It takes great medical minds to create powerful solutions that solve some of healthcare’s most complex challenges. Join us and put your expertise to work in ways you never imagined possible. We know you’ve honed your career in a fast-moving medical environment. While Gainwell operates with a sense of urgency, you’ll have the opportunity to work more flexible hours. And working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work-life balance, continuous learning, and career development.

Summary

As a Principal Medicaid Pharmacy Strategist, PDL, Pricing & Contracting at Gainwell, you will contribute your pharmacy, Medicaid, analytical, and clinical expertise to support state Medicaid pharmacy programs and the populations they serve. This role supports the development and maintenance of Medicaid Preferred Drug Lists (PDLs), clinical coverage criteria, drug cost analyses, and supplemental rebate strategies.

The ideal candidate will be a pharmacist with extensive knowledge of Medicaid pharmacy operations, including drug pricing methodologies, supplemental rebate programs, Medicaid Drug Rebate Program concepts, clinical criteria development, and pharmacy point-of-sale (POS) claims processing. This position requires a strong ability to translate complex clinical, utilization, pricing, and rebate data into actionable recommendations for Medicaid clients.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to independently analyze large and complex pharmacy datasets are essential to success in this role.

Your role in our mission

• Support Medicaid Preferred Drug List (PDL) strategy through analysis of drug products, clinical criteria, utilization, pricing, and rebate opportunities.

• Conduct financial analyses using drug pricing, utilization, and Medicaid rebate data to support formulary and coverage recommendations.

• Evaluate clinical criteria, prior authorizations, and pharmacy benefit requirements to optimize access, cost, and rebate outcomes.

• Analyze utilization, expenditures, pricing trends, and supplemental rebate offers to develop client recommendations.

• Build reports, forecasts, and analytical models using advanced Excel and large datasets.

• Present findings to clients and committees, translating complex clinical and financial data into actionable recommendations.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement PDL, rebate, and pharmacy program strategies.

• Monitor market developments, validate program data, and maintain accurate analytical documentation.

What we're looking for

• Licensed Pharmacist (RPh or PharmD) in the U.S.

• 5+ years of pharmacy experience, including Medicaid pharmacy, managed care, PBM operations, formulary management, or related areas.

• Strong knowledge of Medicaid pharmacy programs, including PDLs, utilization management, prior authorization, claims adjudication, and pharmacy benefit operations.

• Experience with drug pricing, Medicaid rebates, supplemental rebates, pharmaceutical contracting, and financial analysis.

• Experience developing or evaluating formularies, PDLs, prior authorization, and utilization management criteria.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including analysis of large datasets and financial modeling.

• Ability to translate clinical, pricing, utilization, and rebate data into sound pharmacy benefit recommendations.

• Preferred: Experience supporting state Medicaid PDL programs, Medicaid supplemental rebate programs, rebate pools, or multi-state contracting initiatives.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience identifying and reconciling data discrepancies across multiple sources.

What you should expect in this role

• 100% Remote (U.S. only)

• Travel: Up to 10%

Applications will be accepted through November 13, 2026.

title: Global Head of Strategic Deals
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken https://kraken.tech/ powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in

You'll own the commercial negotiation of our largest customer deals end to end. That covers tier-1 SaaS, managed services, and core billing platform deals with regulated utilities and energy retailers. You'll report to the Chief Commercial Officer and carry board-level accountability for deals above $100m.

- Executive sponsor and deal owner: holds the mandate on our side, approves the commercial envelope, and breaks deadlocks fast.

- Lead negotiator: runs the table, controls pacing and concessions, and stays separate from the delivery owner. This is the seat you'll usually hold.

- Pricing and deal economics lead: builds the deal model and covers pricing structures, margin, cash flow, and cost to serve.

- Legal and contracts counsel: covers liability caps, intellectual property (IP) ownership, indemnities, termination, data protection, and the exit terms we can accept.

- Solution architect and delivery lead: tests feasibility, scope, service levels (SLAs), and migration plans, and signs off what we can commit to.

- Sales and account lead: owns the customer relationship, the pursuit plan, and executive sponsorship on the customer side.

- Finance: covers payment terms, currency and indexation, revenue recognition, and approval thresholds.

- Risk, security, and compliance: handles regulatory, data residency, and resilience requirements.

- Set the commercial playbook: pricing architecture, walk-away positions, a concession log, and fallback positions on liability, service levels, and exit.

- Agree one position before you sit down. Rank priorities as must-have, trade, or give, and define your walk-away point (your best alternative to a negotiated agreement, or BATNA).

- Structure deals that fit the risk and protect our margin: per-account bands, volume tiers, indexation, and price-down glide paths, with clear limits on how far we'll go.

- Decide which risks to accept, share, or refuse, and put a price on each one.

- Negotiate core billing and Customer Information System (CIS) replacements, including migration plans, regulatory change, service levels, and exit terms.

- Define scope precisely: baseline, assumptions, dependencies, and exclusions. Most disputes start here, so you'll settle them before signature.

- Set tiered deal-approval thresholds and discount discipline, so concessions on price and liability stay inside policy.

- Shape pursuits with Sales, from capture planning to executive briefings, and build the case to win against incumbent billing vendors.

- Handle the customer's leverage tactics, such as a competing bid, a procurement deadline, or a "sign now" ask, without giving away margin.

- Bring Delivery and Product into the deal early, so scope, migration plans, and roadmap commitments are signed off before contract.

- Protect margin after signature: keep change-order discipline and scope control, and track renewals and expansion alongside the headline price.

Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.
Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well - respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.

This is a new seat created by growth - driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

title: Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Job title: Principle Regulatory Affairs Specialist - DACH
Department: Regulatory Affairs
Location: This role can be based remotely in Germany, with occasional travel to our Darmstadt office
Working hours: Full time
A brighter future awaits you
CooperVision is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of soft contact lenses with a presence in over 100 countries. Being part of CooperVision means helping improve the way people see each day. It’s more than making contact lenses, it’s about giving lens wearers freedom and confidence to move about their daily lives. We’re all about bright futures - for our people and those who wear our contact lenses.
Job summary - What to expect:
The Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist will provide expert level regulatory support and direction across our D-A-CH cluster ( including some Eastern Europe locations), for products from concept to launch, and beyond into post market, as well as regulatory processes. This role is responsible for delivering high‑quality regulatory partnership and ensuring market access across a the cluster. Operating as a strategic regulatory partner to Cluster Leadership Teams, the Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist drives regulatory strategies that enable business growth and safeguard CooperVision’s license to operate. This role is accountable for developing and executing regulatory strategies, driving high‑quality regional submissions, ensuring compliance with EU MDR and regional regulations, and maintaining accurate, audit‑ready regulatory documentation.
Responsibilities include:
1. Regulatory Strategy & Leadership

• Develop and execute regulatory strategies for assigned cluster markets aligned to commercial priorities and lifecycle needs.

• Serve as the primary regulatory partner to Cluster Leadership Teams, providing expert, actionable guidance.

• Lead creation and improvement of regional regulatory processes, SOPs and best practices.

• Represent RA in cross‑functional meetings, providing clear regulatory direction and risk‑based decision‑making.

2. Cluster Partnership & Commercial Collaboration

• Participate in Cluster Leadership Team activities, influencing commercial planning, forecasting, and launch decisions.

• Provide regulatory impact assessments for cluster business strategies, promotions, NPLCOs and private label initiatives.

• Partner with Global Packaging/Labelling to ensure compliant labelling aligned to market needs.

3. Registration & Market Access

• Prepare, review and approve regulatory submissions for assigned EMEA markets, covering new registrations, renewals, amendments, and notifications.

• Maintain accurate, complete, and audit‑ready submission documentation and databases

• Support interactions with Competent Authorities, Notified Bodies and regulatory agencies.

4. Monitoring & Intelligence

• Monitor regional and national regulatory changes and assess business impact.

• Communicate relevant regulatory intelligence to cluster and regional leadership promptly.

• Establish and maintain productive relationships with government, industry groups and regulatory bodies.

5. Labelling, Advertising & Product Compliance

• Review and approve product labelling and cluster‑specific artwork.

• Provide RA input into Regulatory Affairs Impact Documents (RAIDs).

• Ensure adherence to MDR, market‑specific requirements, and CooperVision policies.

• Support Own Brand/Private Label customers and associated regulatory obligations.

6. Technical Documentation & Audit Activities

• Review and assess technical documentation for compliance with MDR and other applicable regulations.

• Contribute to technical audits and inspection readiness within assigned markets.

• Support responses to Notified Body queries, audit findings, and corrective actions.

7. Cross‑Functional & Regional Contribution

• Mentor and guide junior specialists working on cluster‑related submissions or activities.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across EMEA

title: CX Learning & Development Manager
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is looking for a Learning & Development Manager to own how our CX teams, customers, and partners learn Benchling. You’ll build the self-serve courses and learning paths that reach all three, and manage the learning platform that delivers them. When it works, scientists spend their time on science, partners deliver with confidence, and the same questions stop landing in support queues. This role is for someone who is motivated by helping users succeed with a great self-serve experience.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Author courses and assessments focused on use and administration of the Benchling platform and features.

- Design and maintain the LMS content architecture across our three personas (internal, customer, partners): learning plans, course libraries, learner UX.

- Leverage learner feedback, SME input, and our product roadmap to decide what to improve, retire, or build next for each audience.

- Develop scalable onboarding and continuous learning programs for CX roles including Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support, partnering with subject matter experts across CX to turn complex product and process knowledge into engaging content.

- Deliver learning content to people where they work, including in-app guidance and help docs.

- Own our learning platform (Docebo today) like a product, focused on creating a high-quality experience for all users. Set the improvement roadmap and handle day-to-day administration.

- Use AI to shorten the path from idea to published course.

- Increase program effectiveness, completion, and engagement. Connect learning to product adoption and customer retention.

- Refine and execute on governance processes for eLearning content lifecycle management: creation, review cadences, version control, and deprecation.

- Collaborate with Benchling colleagues across the Knowledge & Digital Experience program to align LMS content strategy with Benchling’s broader knowledge ecosystem.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of experience in learning & development, instructional design, or enablement within a B2B SaaS company, vertical or Life Science SaaS preferred.

- Demonstrated content development skills and a track record of designing and building end-to-end curriculum, including learning paths and assessments, not just maintaining content. Can author or direct clear, engaging enablement materials without always having deep domain expertise.

- Experience working with engineering and product teams, and developing learning content focused on the use and administration of software products.

- Experience with eLearning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Rise 360, or similar) and assessment tools (e.g. Skillable, Quest

title: ProAdmin Solutions Director
description:
About the Role
WinTech is seeking an experienced professional to accelerate growth of ProAdmin, our defined benefit calculation engine, used on its own and embedded within pension administration systems. You will shape our go-to-market strategy and build relationships across the plan sponsor ecosystem including plan sponsors, Pension Administration System (PAS) partners, and pension consultants. The role has two parts: building partnerships with PAS vendors that embed ProAdmin, and selling directly to plan sponsors who want greater confidence in their benefit calculations.

What You Will Do

• Build and execute a strategy aligned to our growth objectives.

• Lead each opportunity end to end, from finding and qualifying prospects through closing and onboarding new customers and partners.

• Build and manage PAS partnerships: identify and prioritize vendors, negotiate commercial agreements, and run joint pursuits where ProAdmin is embedded as the calculation engine.

• Earn the trust of plan sponsor leaders, PAS partners, and pension consultants through a working knowledge of how plan sponsors operate and what they need.

• Show plan sponsors how ProAdmin addresses problems such as calculation errors and the need for confidence in benefit calculations.

• Represent WinTech at industry events.

What You Bring
You know the defined benefit (DB) market and how plan sponsors work, and you have a record of building pipeline and growing revenue.

• 10+ years of experience in business development or pension consulting within the DB plan space. Public sector experience is required; private sector experience is a plus.

• Knowledge of who makes and influences decisions at plan sponsors, and comfort working with fund administrators, executive directors, technology leaders, and consultants.

• A record of closing long, complex deals with several decision-makers, RFPs, and board or executive sign-off.

• Experience building channel, OEM, or technology partnerships, including negotiating commercial terms and co-selling with partners.

• Sound commercial judgment and strong communication and relationship skills.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, retirement services, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.

• Ability to travel as needed.

Nice to Have
Any of the following will help you get up to speed faster.

• Experience selling pension software, actuarial or pension consulting services, or other retirement technology.

• Familiarity with plan sponsors, PAS providers, pension consultants, and retirement technology platforms.

Why Join Us
This role gives you the opportunity to shape WinTech’s growth, build senior relationships across the plan sponsor ecosystem, and influence how we bring ProAdmin to market. You will work across WinTech to turn customer needs and market intelligence into opportunities for both our clients and our business.
We are building this part of the business, so the role will evolve and you should be comfortable with shifting priorities.

Coherence OS is an AI-native operating system focused on preserving human meaning, identity, and ethical coherence in the age of advanced automation.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

 

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

 
 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to build the backbone of applied artificial intelligence for our customers. You will design, build, and deploy robust, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure that powers cutting-edge data and machine learning workflows. Working in a cross-functional team, you'll solve complex challenges and empower our data scientists and ML engineers to deploy their work effectively, shaping the future of AI solutions.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 

- Building robust, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure for AI and ML workflows.

- Partnering with technical and non-technical stakeholders, from initial idea generation through to implementation and shipping.

- Enabling Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists by contributing to internal best practices, standards, and reusable code repos.

- Proactively identifying and recommending new ways customers can leverage cloud infrastructure to solve their key challenges.

- Creating and maintaining reusable, company-wide libraries and infrastructure-as-code.

- Researching and integrating the best open-source technologies to enhance Faculty's infrastructure capabilities.

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 

- You are pragmatic and outcome-focused, balancing the big picture with the details to execute complex projects in the real world.

- You think scientifically, always testing assumptions, seeking evidence, and looking for opportunities to improve how things are done.

- You have a drive to learn, constantly exploring new technologies and novel applications for existing tools.

- You possess deep experience with both Azure and AWS as well as Infrastructure as Code, especially Terraform.

- You are experienced in building and deploying containerized solutions using Docker and Kubernetes, supported by strong CI/CD and GitOps practices.

- You possess proficient knowledge of Networking and Cloud Security

- You excel at working directly with clients and stakeholders, confidently handling requirements gathering, technical planning, and scoping.

 

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 

1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

Vertical Relevance is an AWS Premier Tier Partner, and the CP sells across all seven of our AWS practice competencies, from platform foundations, security, and resiliency through application modernization, data, and AI. Our Seven AWS Competencies

Enterprise Program Governance / PMO: Program and engagement management, IT transformation, mergers and acquisitions, and integration offices for large cloud programs

Security & Compliance: SecOps platforms that deliver security and compliance policies as code, including identity and control foundations, policy as code, and our Control Broker asset

•
Data & Analytics: DataOps platforms for data ingestion, governance, and analytics, including lakehouse, data mesh, data marketplace, and catalog work

AI: Designing, building, and tuning AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions on AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker) and with Anthropic Claude

•

Utilizing a consultative approach, you will configure software solutions, coordinate logistics, and deliver tailored training to set each restaurant up for long-term success. • Familiarity with cross-functional collaboration alongside Sales, Customer Success, or Billing teams.

• Experience refining or scaling onboarding programs and operational processes.

• Demonstrated ability to make sound, fact-based decisions independently within ambiguous situations.

• A degree or equivalent practical experience in a related field.

The role provides the data and analytics foundation used by Security Operations while extending traditional SIEM capabilities through behavioral analytics, automation, AI-assisted correlation, and observability for autonomous and agentic systems.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and operate scalable security analytics platforms and telemetry pipelines.

• Integrate, normalize, enrich, and correlate telemetry from endpoint, identity, cloud, application, infrastructure, network, and AI-enabled systems.

• Develop and tune behavioral detections, correlation logic, dashboards, and alerting strategies.

• Translate threat intelligence, incidents, vulnerability findings, and offensive-security results into improved detection content.

• Build observability for AI agents and autonomous workflows, including identity, tool usage, execution activity, and security-relevant behavior.

• Apply AI-assisted techniques to log analysis, correlation, anomaly detection, enrichment, and investigation support.

• Automate telemetry management and security workflows while maintaining appropriate human oversight and explainability.

• Optimize SIEM and related systems platform reliability, data quality, performance, retention, and cost.

Qualifications

• Experience engineering SIEM, security analytics, detection, observability, or large-scale telemetry systems.

• Strong knowledge of logging, event correlation, normalization, enrichment, and security data pipelines.

• Experience developing detections, behavioral analytics, or correlation logic.

• Experience integrating security telemetry from diverse enterprise and cloud environments.

• Scripting or software-development experience and familiarity with APIs and Infrastructure-as-Code.

• Understanding of modern cloud and distributed architectures.

• Familiarity with security telemetry standards, MITRE ATT&CK, AI-assisted analytics, or observability of AI/agentic systems is preferred.

title: Team Leader
description:
Overview
Change Grow Live are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives. Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our teams apply these daily, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.
Our Team Leaders here at Change Grow Live play an integral role in ensuring an effective service provision for our service users by creating a focused culture, engaging staff to provide an innovative and continually improving service and provide leadership, support, and development to a wide range of staff.
We have a new and exciting opportunity for a Team Leader to join our County South in Nottinghamshire Service . As part of our co-occurring mental health and substance use team, you will work flexibly and creatively to ensure what is needed to have the most positive impact for all who are referred to our service.
Where : Nottinghamshire Hours: Full Time, 37.5 hours per week
Contract Type : Permanent
Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.
Responsibilities
About the role:
As Team Leader, you will work as part of the service, developing and strengthening the pathways for service users exiting structured treatment and entering a recovery-focused, bespoke groupwork program. The Team Leader will line manager several Recovery Coordinators working across the County and various locations. The role will involve the creation and development of new provision, tailored to meet the needs of service users who have successfully completed their treatment journey.

• Operational line management of a team of staff which includes supervision (with reflective practice), appraisal, performance and sickness management as well as ensuring staff follow CGL and external policies applicable to their roles

• Lead the delivery of a high-quality, person-centred recovery support service that empowers individuals to achieve positive outcomes and sustain long-term recovery.

• Manage caseload oversight and service performance, ensuring interventions are delivered safely, effectively, and in line with organisational policies and evidence-based practice.

• Promote a culture of continuous improvement, learning, and innovation, ensuring the service remains responsive to the needs of service users and local communities.

• Develop and maintain strong partnerships with internal teams, statutory agencies, health services, local authorities, criminal justice partners, housing providers, and community organisations to improve outcomes and pathways for service users.

About you:

• Experience of working with Adults experiencing difficulties around substance use and multiple complexities.

• Educated to degree level or equivalent experience

• Excellent knowledge of drugs and alcohol and their effects.

• Line management experience

• The ability to lead, empower and motivate a team.

• Excellent knowledge of safeguarding policies and practices and experience of embedding these operationally.

• The ability to foster new partnerships and to maintain positive relationships with partner agencies.

• Knowledge of a range of psychosocial and evidence-based interventions around substance misuse.

• Knowledge and experience of community-based support/outreach practices.

• Ability to ensure all record keeping, outcome monitoring and data collection is maintained effectively.

• Communicate confidently and effectively, verbally and in writing.

• Respond flexibly to the demands of the post.

• The ability to keep calm under pressure.

• Show commitment to facilitating positive outcomes for Adults.

What We Offer

• Enjoy a dedicated weekly Wellness Hour, access to our Wellness Hub, and a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme to support your mental and emotional health.

• We’re committed to you

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

- Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

- Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

- Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

- Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

- Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

- The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

- Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

- Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

- Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

- Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

- You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

- You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.

- You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.

title: Warehouse Supervisor - Manchester
description:
WAREHOUSE SUPERVISOR

Location: Manchester (M12)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers-come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Manchester team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/operations/ team - what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

- Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

- Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

- Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

- Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

- Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

- Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

- Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

- Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

- Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

- Step 1: Apply - Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

- Step 2: Online assessment - If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

- Step 3: Initial conversation - One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

- Step 4: Final Onsite interview - You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

- Step 5: Outcome - We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

WHY JOIN US?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace - working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

As our portfolio expands, we’re excited to welcome Principal Designer - CDM who share our passion for collaboration, innovation, and creating a sustainable future.

Acting on behalf of the Principal Designer under National Grid’s SR188 framework, you will play a key role in ensuring compliance with  CDM Regulations 2015 , driving high standards of health, safety, and risk management throughout the project lifecycle.
